What a swimmer runs into on the current page
  • The page says “Temporarily closed for maintenance until 11/6”; the brochure says through November 11. The calendar follows the page.
  • The page lists Monday hours; the brochure says the pool is closed Mondays.
  • Neither says when lap swim and rec swim run; both list only “Hours of Operation”.
